issues.title: Identify the components behind semantic detection
issues.explanation: The frozen verifier rejected 16 of 19 resealed contradictions; the separate source observer detected the remaining 3. The combined audit is 19/19, but a reader reproducing only the standalone frozen verifier does not get that coverage. This qualifies the scope and does not dispute the combined total. The later verifier amendment must not be attributed retroactively to the frozen campaign.
issues.recommendation: Identify verificador congelado y observador independiente in the table/prose. The final amendment paragraph should retain 16/19 + 3/19, then describe the new verifier tests and explicit externally anchored legacy option. Preserve raw exports and source hashes.

claimJudgment.storage: Sampled XFS blocks, original decisions, incomplete or unknown cases and exclusions are qualified. The rejected 39 MiB cases that completed under a counterfactual remain separate from real admission. The 50% boundary false rejection and failure of the 5% target are explicit.
claimJudgment.steric: The primary 180-second denominators retain 105/108. Five published problem cases remain distinct from 73 unlabelled originals and 30 experimental references. No classifier cutoff or physical sensitivity/specificity is inferred.
claimJudgment.sasa: Area evaluation of 108/108 remains distinct from applicability of charged-sidechain medians in 79/108. Missing or absent sidechains are not zeros. Four positions across ten repeats are not a time series. Isolated-chain scope and preparation differences are explicit.
claimJudgment.scientificMetricClosure: No scientific completion of R1.3, R1.5, R3.3 or R3.8 is asserted in the figures or result table.
